class.name: ResourceDatabase
class.brief_description: Keeps resources in memory and finds them by path, key, type or pattern.

method.name: add_resource
method.description: Stores [param resource] under [param key], replacing an entry with the same key. If the resource has a path, it can also be found by that path. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param key] is empty or [param resource] is [code]null[/code].

method.name: add_resource_if_missing
method.description: Stores [param resource] under [param key] if nothing is stored under that key yet. Returns [code]true[/code] if it was stored. The check and the insertion happen atomically, so several threads can use it to store a resource only once.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every entry. Resources that nothing else references are freed.

method.name: find_keys
method.description: Like [method find_resources], but returns the paths or keys under which the matching resources are stored.

method.name: find_resources
method.description: Returns the stored resources whose path or key matches [param pattern] and whose class is [param type] or inherits from it. [param type] can be a native class or a script [code]class_name[/code]. An empty pattern or type matches everything.

method.name: get_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of stored entries. Keys added by [member Preloads.keys] or [method preload_resource] are other names for an entry and are not counted.

method.name: get_memory_usage
method.description: Returns an estimate in bytes of the memory used by the stored resources: the stored properties (strings, packed arrays, arrays, dictionaries and sub-resources, each resource counted once). Video memory (textures and meshes on the [RenderingServer]) and native data that is not a stored property are not counted.

method.name: get_preload_progress
method.description: Returns the files loaded so far by the preloads that run on a worker thread right now. Every file counts the same. The result is finished (see [method LoadProgress.is_finished]) if nothing is preloading. Use the signal [signal preload_progress] to be told about every step.

method.name: get_resource
method.description: Returns the resource stored under the path or key [param key_or_path], or [code]null[/code]. Paths can be given as [code]uid://[/code] paths too. Keys that are not paths are case-sensitive.

method.name: has_resource
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a resource is stored under the path or key [param key_or_path].

method.name: is_preloading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a preload started with [method preload_from] on a worker thread has not finished (until its [signal preload_finished] is emitted).

method.name: preload_from
method.description: Loads everything [param preloads] names and stores it: the resources of [member Preloads.resources] under their path (or their [member Resource.resource_name] if they have no path), the files of [member Preloads.paths] and [member Preloads.manifests] under their resource path. Then the keys of [member Preloads.keys] are added. Resources that are already loaded are not loaded again. If [param use_threads] is [code]true[/code] and threads are available, the files load on a worker thread and the method returns at once; otherwise it returns when everything is loaded. [signal preload_finished] is emitted on the main thread in both cases. Returns the first error found ([constant OK] if there was none). Files that fail to load are skipped; the others are still loaded.

method.name: preload_resource
method.description: Loads the resource at [param path] now and stores it under its resource path. If [param key] is not empty, the resource can also be found by that key.

method.name: remove_matching
method.description: Removes every entry whose path or key matches [param pattern] (see the class description) and returns the number of removed entries. An empty pattern matches every entry. Resources that nothing else references are freed.

signal.name: preload_finished
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when [method preload_from] has loaded [param preloads]. [param error] is the first [enum Error] found, or [constant OK].

signal.name: preload_progress
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread each time a file of [param preloads] is loaded (or failed to load) by [method preload_from]. [param progress] holds the files done and the total, for example for a "3 / 12 loaded" label; the files of [member Preloads.manifests] are counted too. Direct resources and keys are not counted. The last emission is complete and comes before [signal preload_finished]. Without thread support the files load inside the call, so the signals follow on the next frame at once; a [TransitionScreen] steps through the files frame by frame there instead.
